name: schema-version-bump-new-target
description: A define-field version bump that changes strategy MUST declare a distinct target (spec/schema-ops.md §Evolution, Correction 1): op_version 1 of widget-op declares field 'value' as lww; op_version 2 redeclares 'value' as set-union under target 'value_v2' instead of reusing 'value'. Without the distinct target, Fold groups both versions' rules by target key alone and instantiates one accumulator from whichever rule a caller's slice lists first — order-dependent, which is exactly what the target remedy avoids. With it, v1's register and v2's register are two independent state keys and neither strategy ever sees the other version's writes.
